# ssync_alert (Resource)

The alert records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `sa_owner_id` (String)

### Optional

- `days_before` (Number) For subscription_expiring, how many days ahead of the expiry the rule fires
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `severity` (Dynamic)
